thread:
maya: FYI we ran a focused shadow of ranker-xq4 (quantized variant) overnight on long-docs. latency -18%, infra cost -28%, but long-doc MRR down ~1.6%.
sam: sample size?
maya: ~3.9k requests, 4.5h, docs >3000 tokens. baseline MRR 0.410, ranker-xq4 0.403, p~0.03. global MRR flat.
jordan: p is weak. our generic canary would flip on this; long-doc variance is high so we need slice-aware rules.
evan: current rule = fallback if relative drop >2% AND p<0.01 OR abs drop >0.03. not suitable here.
sam: proposal: slice-aware gate: for long-docs require relative_drop>1.5% AND cohen_d>0.17 OR sustained drop across 3 windows. also use entropy/JS divergence checks.
jordan: add: if score entropy decreases >9% AND MRR drop >1% -> stricter halt.
maya: ops note: because cost savings are significant, allow opt-in routing for cost-sensitive customers; default route long-docs to baseline until we clear A/B.
evan: I'll add entropy and JS-divergence sensors to canary engine and create a slice-specific policy.
sam: I'll run a targeted A/B (10% long-doc routing) for 48h and produce hourly slice reports.
deploy-bot: scheduled: canary-config ranker-xq4-slice-v1 deploy to staging at 2026-03-21T14:20Z.
